svg.text: One service account per job: generator = publisher only · push identity = only invoker of the enricher (no allUsers) · enricher = write curated only

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: No service-account keys anywhere · analysts hold no access to raw/curated, only to authorized views that hash the email · schema violations never enter the system

text.font-family: Inter, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Build: dedicated Cloud Build SA, digest-pinned image · state in a versioned private bucket

svg.text: The enricher validates, converts to EUR, and inserts into curated.orders (event_id as the insert id); a materialized view aggregates per minute

svg.text: Invalid events return 422; Pub/Sub retries with backoff and after 5 attempts forwards the message to events-dlq
